items:
Situated just north of the town square and in the heart of Seaside, Mint 4 Fun, with 5 bedrooms, 5 baths and an enclosed tower room with balcony is definitely MEANT FOR FUN!

MInt 4 Fun has large, covered porches on the main floor and second floor. The second floor porch has private entrances from 2 separate bedrooms. All bedrooms have en suite baths.

A tower room with open balcony on the fourth level affords nice views of the gulf and all of Seaside and is a fantastic place to enjoy the sunset or your morning coffee.
The design of this home is architecturally unique.
From the bunk room with a spacious hideaway loft, the 30' cathedral ceilings in the living room, and the close proximity to all the Seaside amenities, you will be amazed with this property!

Mint 4 Fun is just a few steps from the west-end pool and only a couple blocks to the private Pensacola beach pavilion.
We have a large wagon, a rolling cooler, some beach chairs and beach toys for your use.
The Seaside chapel, playground, fitness center, and 3 community pools are all close by (Seaside charges a fee to use the pools, fitness and tennis amenities. This fee is optional and not included in the rent).

The fully stocked kitchen has granite countertops, glass tile backsplash, stainless appliances and all the "tools" you will need for those days you want to cook at home.

There are hardwood floors throughout the house and custom wood shutters for every window.

Of course the powdery white sand and crystal clear ocean is what brings you here, but other highlights of staying in Seaside that you will enjoy are shopping in the many quaint shops, eating at the award winning restaurants, bike riding through town, strolling down the hidden paths or relaxing on the outdoor porches enjoying the fragrant sea air and warm breezes.
